title: A Gravity for the Colony
author: Lena Quintana
blurb: Yara Oyelaran, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
